title: Iran says it will respond ‘with firmness’ after Sirik attack
summary:
Iran says it will respond ‘with firmness’ after Sirik attack

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said on Tuesday that Iran will respond "with firmness" to the lastest round of US strikes on the country, despite US President Donald Trump's warnings that Iran would be "totally wiped out" if it attempts to retaliate.

"The United States’ catalogue of atrocities against the nation of Iran is now complete: a residential home in Kuhestak, Sirik, was brutally attacked tonight while families were celebrating a wedding. More than 50 innocent men, women and children were martyred or wounded," Baqaei wrote in a post to X.

Baqaei also criticised governments and international institutions that remain silent or seek to justify such attacks, saying "their silence is not neutrality" and warning that those who remain silent "will not be immune to its consequences tomorrow".

title: No casualties, minimal damage from US attack on Jiroft Airport
summary:
No casualties, minimal damage from US attack on Jiroft Airport

No casualties or damage to airport infrastructure have been reported after US strikes targeting Jiroft Airport on Tuesday, according to the deputy governor of Iran's Kerman province.

In comments carried by Iran’s Fars News Agency, the deputy governor said a projectile landed outside the airport’s runway and the situation is “under control”.

title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses

KrebsOnSecurity also has learned that the New Orleans field office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) today launched an official inquiry into the source of the images.

title: Two Alleged ‘TeamPCP’ Hackers Arrested in Australia
summary:
Authorities in Australia have arrested two men believed to be members of TeamPCP, a prolific cybercrime and data extortion group blamed for perpetrating the longest running spree of software supply chain attacks ever.

In a statement released today, the Australian Federal Police (AFP) said two unnamed suspects from Western Australia, aged 21 and 23, were arrested in connection with a "sophisticated cybercrime syndicate that allegedly created malicious open-source software to rob thousands of global businesses."

The AFP did not name the defendants, but KrebsOnSecurity learned the 21-year-old suspect's real identity in June, and has been communicating with him ever since. This story includes interviews with TeamPCP's self-described spokesperson, and examines clues left behind by the TeamPCP leader that likely led to his undoing.

title: Who’s Tracking You? Use This New Service to Find Out

title: Israel-Greece air defence deal to be 'scaled up' with UAE as contender, sources say
summary:
Israel-Greece air defence deal to be 'scaled up' with UAE as contender, sources say

Israel plans to “scale up” the export of the layered air-defence system it sold to Greece, with the UAE as its desired buyer, one current and one former US official familiar with ongoing discussions told Middle East Eye.

Talks between Israel and the UAE, taking place alongside the US, are focused on how Israel can address a gap in the Emirates’ “layered defence” capabilities, the current US official told MEE.

Israel’s $3.5bn sale to Greece on Monday is being described as a model for how it can export its systems and design to other partners.

“This is a profit machine for Israel that they are looking to scale up,” the former US official familiar with the matter told MEE.

“Israel’s layered air defence systems are cheaper and more exportable than ours [the US’s],” they added.

The UAE is a prime candidate because it already cooperates on defence with Israel.

The US said that Israel deployed Iron Dome missile defence batteries and technicians to the UAE during the height of fighting with Iran earlier this year. The Financial Times reported that Israel also sent a drone detection platform to the UAE.

MEE revealed in May that the two countries sealed a deal to pursue the joint development and acquisition of weapons systems.

The UAE already operates US-made Patriot and Thaad air defence systems. The Breaking Defence news site reported in 2022 that the UAE also purchased Israel's Barak air defence system. 

"[But] the UAE does not have a fully layered air-defence system," the US official told MEE.

title: Iran says it launched drone attacks on US base in Bahrain
summary:
Iran says it launched drone attacks on US base in Bahrain

The Iranian military said that it targeted a US base in Bahrain with a large-scale drone attack, according to a statement carried by Tasnim news agency on Tuesday.

The army said the strikes were carried out on radar installations and areas where it says US forces are stationed at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain, a key base in the Gulf used to house reconnaissance aircraft, and as a maintenance centre for helicopters and drone components.

title: No US casualties reported so far in Iran attack on Jordan facilities, officials say
summary:
No US casualties reported so far in Iran attack on Jordan facilities, officials say

No US casualties have been reported so far from an Iranian attack on facilities in Jordan, two US officials told Reuters on Tuesday.

Jordanian air defences intercepted 10 out of 13 ballistic missiles entering their airspace from Iran, while the remaining three fell in remote areas away from population centres, according to a statement from the country's military.

title: IRGC says it 'killed a large number of US forces' in Jordan attack
summary:
IRGC says it 'killed a large number of US forces' in Jordan attack

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Tuesday that it targeted an American base in Jordan which "killed a large number of US forces", according to a statement.

No confirmation yet from Jordan or the US following the strikes.
